messages:
nora: FYI we just got pinged by two customers about a competitor's new auto-fallback feature. Can we do a quick triage?

ajay: I looked. They implemented per-tenant routing policies that downgrade to smaller quantized models under high load. Seems infra-heavy but doable.

lina: Sales note: FinTech pilot flagged this as a must-have to close. They want a toggle and contractual SLA for fallback behavior.

tom: Main engineering concerns: KV cache isolation (stateful models) and consistent token-state across variant swaps. If we don't namespace keys we'll leak contexts.

maria: Product question: do we match exactly or ship a curated subset? My suggestion: API-first canary called "fallback_policy" with three modes: "latency-first", "cost-aware", "off". No Console UI in v1.

ajay: Ballpark: 3w to get an API + routing glue + telemetry + runbook for canary. +1w for rollout automation. Full console/RBAC/pricing ~8w.

nora: Proposed canary acceptance: deterministic fallback semantics documented; p99 latency regression <5% for target models; observable reroute telemetry.

maria: Also include explicit pin option so customers can opt-out of silent variant swaps. And cost-guard rails so fallbacks don't blow budgets.

lina: If we commit to the 3w canary sales can accelerate two deals. They need enterprise toggle language in contracts.

tom: Mitigation idea: prefix KV keys with model variant id. Example snippet: ```json
{
  "kv_key": "{{model_id}}:{{model_variant}}:{{request_hash}}"
}```

ajay: Routing config sketch (temporary YAML): ```yaml
routing:
  tiers:
    - name: latency-first
      max_latency_ms: 50
    - name: cost-aware
      max_cost_usd: 0.0002
```

maria: Decision: scope canary to API flag + server-side routing + telemetry + SRE runbook. No console changes in v1. Product will own the launch checklist and docs.

nora: Owners: Ajay (eng lead), Tom (infra/ML), Maria (PM), Lina (sales liaison). I'll set a 30m sync tomorrow to confirm scope.

release-bot: Deploy started: feature/model-fallback -> staging at 2089050200

ajay: I'll open the PR and post an ETA by EOD.

lina: I'll draft customer comms and contract bullet points.

maria: Messaging guardrail: emphasize "graceful fallback and cost controls" not "identical behavior". Avoid promising parity.

tom: I'll spike KV prefixing and run CI regressions; will post results here.

nora: Meeting invite sent for 2089050300.

ajay: If blockers pop, I'll escalate to #release-war-room. :thumbsup:
